org.name: WATER FIT GENERAL TRADING
org.address: Mickyleyland Street, Bole Sub-City, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
org.profile: A midsized manufacturer, supplier and distributor of water-work related products, with annual sales well over 35 million Ethiopian Birr.
org.exclusion: Clause 8.3 Design and Development – WATER FIT does not design and develop its products or services.
org.manualIssue: Issue 2 · January 2025 – scope expansion: Single Wall Corrugated conduit & Drip Irrigation pipes
org.policy: Waterfit General Trading is committed to manufacture and provide quality plastic products that can satisfy all stakeholders at a timely manner by complying ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System and other applicable requirements.
activities: Manufacturing of HDPE pipes, irrigation pipes and single wall corrugated pipes
Supply to water supply & irrigation projects
products: UPVC & HDPE well casings and screens

strengths: Hard work for quality product, good customer handling and services
Respectful culture – a positive working place
Internationally certified, professional, well-educated skilled employees
Manufacturing HDPE, drip irrigation and single wall corrugated pipes with certified good quality

external.t: Instability in the country, rapid policy changes

external.o: Computerized, time effective, one-window system (networking different working locations to one system)
Few competing companies in pipe manufacturing
external.t: Delayed pipe production caused by raw material shortage

findings.t: Quality objectives (OF/WF/027) not in the document set
findings.d: Clause 6.2 requires measurable objectives; the manual references OF/WF/027 but no file exists.

fix.text: Draft OF/WF/027 with 8 proposed objectives awaiting GM approval; live tracking on Quality Objectives tab

findings.d: OP/WF/001 never states how often documents are re-reviewed. All procedures are still Issue 1 from 2020. The app uses a configurable 3-year cycle.

fix.text: Review rule drafted into OP/WF/001 change request; review cycle is configurable (Users & Settings)

findings.t: No CAPA / NCR closure time limit
findings.d: OP/WF/004 & 005 say "within an agreed time frame". Due dates are set per action in the app.

fix.text: Closure limits drafted (OP/WF/004, 005) and applied in the app as target dates: NCR 14 d, CAPA 30 d, complaint 3 d (72 h SLA)

findings.t: Form number conflicts in system procedures
findings.d: OP/WF/004 cites OF/WF/028 for CAPA (list says 017); OP/WF/003 cites 015 as planning input (planning form is 016); 017/018 both named "NCR".

fix.text: Exact corrections drafted as change requests on OP/WF/003 and OP/WF/004

findings.d: Customer satisfaction cited as OP/WF/025 (actually 032); context cited as OF/WF/031 and 039; interested parties cited as OP/WF/040 (is OF/WF/040); OP/WF/009 cited but not on master list.

fix.text: All manual cross-references corrected in a change request on MN/WF/001

findings.d: Two different customer feedback forms (Amharic recording form and bilingual questionnaire) share number 152.
OF/WF/014 (2020/2021) grid has no months marked. Only one IQA (01/2020, 14 Dec 2020) is evidenced.

fix.text: 2026/27 programme drafted (OF/WF/014 Issue 2) and a QA audit added to the calendar

findings.t: HR templates carry a foreign footer
findings.d: Forms 093, 094, 103, 104, 106, 107 show "Gift Real Estate Plc" footer – adapted from another company.

fix.text: Footer removal raised as a change request (OF/WF/103, applies to 6 forms)

ncr.title: Ovality out of tolerance on 250mm PN16 – coiling
Wall thickness below minimum on 110mm PN10 coils
ncr.description: Measured 6.1 mm vs 6.6 mm minimum at 3 o’clock position; sizing sleeve vacuum low.

ncr.title: Printing illegible on drip irrigation laterals
ncr.description: Ink ribbon misaligned; product marking (size, PN, date, WF) unreadable on 30% of length.

ncr.title: Supplier resin batch with high moisture
ncr.description: Bubbles in extrudate; moisture test above supplier COA.
ncr.verification: Dried 4h at 80°C before use; trial run passed visual & dimensional checks.

ncr.title: Weld bead height insufficient – site joint
ncr.description: Data-log shows heat-soak time short; ambient below 5°C with wind.
ncr.verification: Joints cut and re-welded with wind shelter; data-log approved.

ncr.title: Corrugated pipe crushed during loading
ncr.verification: Crushed and returned to FPS as regrind (OP/WF/037).

capa.title: Preventive maintenance plan (OF/WF/067) not followed for NOVAMEC 03
Quality objectives not defined (clause 6.2)
capa.rootCause: OF/WF/027 never issued after 2020 task force.
capa.actionPlan: Draft measurable objectives per process with KPI matrix (OF/WF/038); GM approval.

capa.title: Prevent moisture-related defects from resin deliveries
capa.rootCause: No incoming moisture check; resin stored outdoors under tarpaulin at supplier and at WF yard.
capa.actionPlan: 1) Add moisture test to GRV inspection. 2) Covered resin store. 3) Notify supplier & add to evaluation.

capa.title: Calibration records missing for 2 pressure gauges
capa.rootCause: No reminder system; calibration card not updated after outsourced calibration.
capa.actionPlan: Register all instruments in QMS calibration module with due-date alerts.

complaints.title: Delivery of 63mm PN10 pipes 9 days late for WASH project

complaints.title: Store keeper customer handling at loading
complaints.resolution: Apology issued; customer-handling training scheduled for store staff.

complaints.title: Coil length short by 4 m on 100 m coils
complaints.resolution: Credit note issued; meter counter recalibrated.
